notes.it: Dedicato al clubbing notturno più cupo. Warmup progressivo da Tech House solida a 126 BPM verso un picco di Techno ipnotica e Acid Techno Drumcode style a 130 BPM.
notes.en: Dedicated to deep underground clubbing. Progressive warmup starting with solid 126 BPM Tech House building into hypnotic Techno and Drumcode-style Acid Techno at 130 BPM.
